acceptanceCriteria: Cargo workspace metadata resolves one aligned version and the version consistency gate passes in all three languages.
Release workflow and policy gates pass without source fallback, mutable tags, unbound assets, or orphan SBOM/provenance files.
The annotated release tag and public Release bind the reviewed source commit, manifest, checksums, five-target archives, SBOMs, formula, and provenance.
Staged and post-release adopter acceptance use downloaded immutable artifacts, prove runtime identity, repository isolation, evidence lifecycle, and cleanup.
N-1 upgrade acceptance passes when a prior public release exists, or records an explicit not_applicable receipt for a first release.
goal: Release ai-cockpit v0.2.86 from the reviewed mainline and prove installation, upgrade, supply-chain, and adopter acceptance using only published artifacts.
intent: Publish the final Runtime release after all six reference-comparison batches are complete, with synchronized version documentation and immutable public-artifact acceptance.
outOfScope: Runtime behavior changes outside release/version binding
Reference-source feature migration or object repositories
Hand-editing generated .ai evidence, archive, or decision records

scenarioCoverage.expected: All workspace packages, current tri-language documentation, annotated tag, manifest, checksums, archives, SBOMs, Formula, and provenance bind to one reviewed commit.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run workspace tests, metadata/version consistency, workflow policy, and release manifest checks.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Downloaded candidate/public artifacts alone establish runtime identity, repository isolation, lifecycle evidence, and temporary-root cleanup.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run wrapper regression tests before publication and the staged/public harnesses at their respective release boundaries.

scenarioCoverage.expected: When a previous public release exists, N-1 upgrade is verified; otherwise the receipt explicitly records not_applicable without weakening publication gates.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Resolve the previous public Release independently and run the N-1 harness against immutable downloaded artifacts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A failed publication or adopter run preserves tag/release truth and emits an auditable failure receipt without source fallback or destructive cleanup of evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run release policy tests and inspect failure-path receipts/manifests without mutating historical release records.
